sentence: This project builds machine-learning tools that speed up physics simulations of stars and their pulsations to model nearby giant stars.
This project sets up a degree program in bioengineering that combines coursework, research and industry work in biotechnology and biomanufacturing.
This project studies how well complicated functions of many yes/no variables can be approximated by simple polynomials.
This project builds robotic hands that can change their stiffness and sense force and slip using event-driven cameras and machine learning.
This project builds software that turns paperback books into digital books for people with challenges reading print.
This project builds deep learning models that work with several kinds of data at once and tries to make them run more efficiently.
This project builds streetscape applications that use real-time local data to make communities safer and more livable.
This project studies how to make deep learning models represent uncertainty and use prior knowledge so they stay reliable in changing environments.
This project studies how to make quantum applications run well across several quantum machines and classical computing nodes together.
This project tries to find out why tadpoles and adult frogs use different kinds of T cells to fight infection.
This project builds computer methods that learn from past design and manufacturing data to turn a digital design into a manufactured product.
This project builds ways to print and erase biomaterials that can sense mechanical force wirelessly.
This project studies how urban heat affects the evolution of thermoregulatory traits and genetic divergence in hummingbirds.
This project tests whether X-ray or near infrared light can switch on bioactive compounds selectively in tissue.
This project studies the challenges that organisms and ecosystems face from rapid environmental change in urban, agricultural and natural systems.
This project makes layered semiconductors from silicon and germanium and studies how their structure affects their optoelectronic properties.
This project plans a center that studies how nature-based solutions can help with urban hydrology challenges caused by climate change.
This project studies programmable photonic chips that run quantum signal processing for quantum computing.
This project builds profiling tools that find what slows down deep learning programs that run on graphics processing units.
